techniques.name: OmniVTA: Visuo-Tactile World Modeling for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
techniques.capability_enabled: World-model-based visuo-tactile manipulation framework with a self-supervised tactile encoder, two-stream visuo-tactile world model predicting short-horizon contact evolution, contact-aware fusion policy, and 60Hz reflexive controller; built on OmniViTac dataset (21,000+ trajectories, 86 tasks).
techniques.code_evidence: WebSearch result block shows a GitHub repository titled 'MrSecant/OmniVTA: OmniVTA: Visuo-Tactile World Modeling for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation' at https://github.com/MrSecant/OmniVTA; result states 'The GitHub repository is available at: https://github.com/MrSecant/OmniVTA'.
techniques.verbatim_quote: OmniVTA is a world-model-based visuo-tactile manipulation framework that integrates four tightly coupled modules: a self-supervised tactile encoder, a two-stream visuo-tactile world model for predicting short-horizon contact evolution, a contact-aware fusion policy for action generation, and a 60Hz reflexive controller that corrects deviations between predicted and observed tactile signals in a closed loop.

techniques.name: Sound2Hap: Learning Audio-to-Vibrotactile Haptic Generation from Human Ratings
techniques.capability_enabled: CNN-based autoencoder (CNN encoder + LSTM + residual vector quantization + SEANet decoder) that generates perceptually meaningful vibrotactile signals from diverse environmental sounds with low latency, trained on human ratings of 1,000 sounds.
techniques.code_evidence: WebSearch returned a GitHub repository 'Iris1215/Sound2Hap' (https://github.com/Iris1215/Sound2Hap); result block states 'the dataset, audio-to-vibration model, and web tool are open-source, with the audio-vibration dataset available on Hugging Face.'
techniques.verbatim_quote: Using this dataset, they trained Sound2Hap, a CNN-based autoencoder, to generate perceptually meaningful vibrations from diverse sounds with low latency.

techniques.name: Machine learning for smell: Ordinal odor strength prediction of molecular perfumery components
techniques.capability_enabled: Curated ordinal odor-strength dataset of 2000+ molecules (odorless/low/medium/high) plus pipeline comparing multiple molecular encodings and supervised learners to predict odor strength directly from molecular structure for fragrance design.
techniques.code_evidence: WebSearch returned a GitHub repository 'peter-fichtelmann/odor-strength' with description 'Python code of the manuscript: Machine learning for smell: Ordinal odor strength prediction of molecular perfumery components' (https://github.com/peter-fichtelmann/odor-strength); result states the Python code v1.0 implements dataset curation, training and evaluation.
techniques.verbatim_quote: The code is available on GitHub at `peter-fichtelmann/odor-strength`.

techniques.name: TouchAnything: Diffusion-Guided 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Robot Touches
techniques.capability_enabled: Leverages a pretrained large-scale 2D vision diffusion model as a semantic and geometric prior to reconstruct accurate 3D geometry from only a few sparse tactile measurements, enabling open-world reconstruction of unseen objects without category-specific training.
techniques.code_evidence: WebSearch shows a project page (https://grange007.github.io/touchanything/) but NO explicit code repository or weights confirmed in result blocks; WebFetch of the project page returned HTTP 403 so code release could not be verified. Note: a DIFFERENT same-named paper (jianyi2004, egocentric-video bimanual tactile) exists and should not be conflated.
techniques.verbatim_quote: TouchAnything is a framework that leverages a pretrained large-scale 2D vision diffusion model as a semantic and geometric prior for 3D reconstruction from sparse tactile measurements.

techniques.name: FG-CLTP: Fine-Grained Contrastive Language Tactile Pretraining for Robotic Manipulation
techniques.capability_enabled: Tactile-language pretraining over 100k+ tactile 3D point-cloud/language pairs capturing quantitative contact states (force magnitude, contact geometry, principal-axis orientation) via discretized numerical tokenization; provides a sensor-agnostic foundation for 3D tactile-language-action models with a flow-matching policy.
techniques.code_evidence: WebSearch result block explicitly states 'the search results don't show specific GitHub repository links for the code or dataset'; no code/weights URL visible.
techniques.verbatim_quote: FG-CLTP is a fine-grained contrastive language tactile pretraining framework that includes a novel dataset comprising over 100k tactile 3D point cloud-language pairs that explicitly capture multidimensional contact states from the sensor's perspective.

techniques.name: Visuo-Tactile World Models (VT-WM)
techniques.capability_enabled: Multi-task visuo-tactile world model that captures the physics of contact through touch reasoning, complementing vision with tactile images to handle occlusion and ambiguous contact; reports 33% better object-permanence and up to 35% higher zero-shot real-robot success on contact-rich tasks.
techniques.code_evidence: WebSearch shows a project page (https://carolinahiguera.github.io/vtml/) but result block states 'I could not locate a specific GitHub code repository page or official code release announcement for this project.'
techniques.verbatim_quote: VT-WM captures the physics of contact through touch reasoning, and by complementing vision with tactile images, it better understands robot-object interactions in contact-rich tasks, avoiding common failure modes of vision-only models under occlusion or ambiguous contact states.

techniques.name: AROMMA: Unifying Olfactory Embeddings for Single Molecules and Mixtures
techniques.capability_enabled: Unified olfactory embedding space for single molecules and two-molecule mixtures: each molecule encoded by a chemical foundation model, mixtures composed by a permutation-invariant attention aggregator, with odor-descriptor alignment via knowledge distillation and class-aware pseudo-labeling; up to 19.1% AUROC improvement.
techniques.code_evidence: WebSearch result block states 'The search results did not return a specific GitHub repository link in the results shown'; no code/weights URL visible (IEEE Xplore + arXiv only).
techniques.verbatim_quote: AROMMA is a framework that learns a unified embedding space for single molecules and two-molecule mixtures, where each molecule is encoded by a chemical foundation model and the mixtures are composed by an attention-based aggregator, ensuring both permutation invariance and asymmetric molecular interactions.

techniques.name: NOSE: Neural Olfactory-Semantic Embedding with Tri-Modal Orthogonal Contrastive Learning
techniques.capability_enabled: Representation-learning framework aligning three modalities of the olfactory pathway (molecular structure, receptor sequence, natural-language description) and decoupling their contributions via orthogonal constraints; uses an LLM to mine weak positive descriptor samples.
techniques.code_evidence: WebSearch result block states 'the search results don't contain specific information about a GitHub code repository link'; no code/weights URL visible.
techniques.verbatim_quote: NOSE (Neural Olfactory-Semantic Embedding) is a representation learning framework that aligns three modalities along the olfactory pathway: molecular structure, receptor sequence, and natural language description.
